title: Stock items: bounded paged reads
summary: Replace the all-items collector with independent, bounded, authorised reads and a sealed page cursor.

provenance.note: Invented example mirroring a real secure paged-reads change.

views.title: Stock items — bounded pages, not a bulk collector
views.subtitle: Each read authorises and meters itself; the page cursor is sealed; the old collector is retired with no fallback.
focus: Rows render even when metadata fails: the loader awaits only the page read.
The page cursor never exposes raw sort values; it is sealed with a deployment key that must be provisioned before rollout.
Three new patterns are proposed (hatched); approve or redirect them.

elements.title: Page loader
elements.subtitle: Awaits rows only; streams metadata seeds
details: Seeds are bound to the viewer and the exact query arguments.
Metadata seeds are started and caught independently.

elements.title: Current-page owner
elements.subtitle: Current + at most one pending page
elements.details: Three automatic empty reads, then an explicit Continue; offscreen pages are never accumulated.

elements.title: Page-start history
elements.subtitle: URL page + session start tokens only
elements.details: Previous/Back read fresh. Unknown ancestry falls back to the first page instead of inventing a previous one.

elements.title: Dashboard stock cards
elements.subtitle: Own summary read; failure doesn't gate the page

elements.title: items.page
elements.subtitle: ready(rows, next) | invalid-cursor | unavailable
elements.details: Every request re-authorises; no identifier-bearing denial.

elements.title: Auth + metered read seam
elements.subtitle: Each producer: auth + fresh budget
details: Runs before traversal or cursor opening.
Hard overflow discards the whole operation.

elements.title: Index merge
elements.subtitle: Sku / name / status / bin; one global cut

elements.title: Sealed page cursor
elements.subtitle: Deterministic authenticated encryption
details: Binds actor, tenant and every normalised control.
Missing key = unavailable; key rotation invalidates saved starts.

elements.title: binPlacements
elements.subtitle: Where an item sits: shelf, bin or zone

divergence.text: Discriminator and id unions are independent.

elements.title: Cursor sealing key
elements.subtitle: 64-byte key per deployment
elements.details: Dev and test slots are provisioned; shared environments need a rollout step before deploy.

clauses.args: tenant + scope / search / types / status / tags / sort / direction / cursor
clauses.returns: ready {rows, next: null | string} | invalid-cursor | unavailable
clauses.access: authenticate + tenant + scope visibility before traversal
clauses.limits: soft 50 rows / 500 candidates; hard call, document and byte ceilings discard the whole operation

clauses.encoding: versioned prefix + base64url ciphertext of a fixed-size padded envelope
clauses.binding: actor + tenant + every normalised scope, filter and sort argument
clauses.security: no readable sort values; re-authorise before opening; no cursor table

notes.text: The shared admission meter predates this change. Callers and ownership change, not the hard ceilings.

notes.title: Rollout step needed
notes.text: Shared environments must provision the sealing key before deploy, or every page read returns unavailable.

notes.title: Existing divergence DV-2
notes.text: Read coherence checks do not repair the schema: level and targetId can still disagree. Not fixed here.
Scope counts are complete counts, not exact version pins. Is that acceptable for dashboard cards?

tours.title: Review: bounded pages replace the bulk collector
tours.summary: What changes, the two read paths, the proposed patterns, then the risks.

steps.title: What changes
steps.body:
Every new, modified and removed card is lit; reused context fades.

The page loader, the live owner and the cards each get their **own** bounded read.

steps.title: Page read path
steps.body: The loader awaits only the page read: `items.page` → index merge → the stock table. One global cut, native index order.

steps.title: Summary read path
steps.body: Dashboard cards subscribe to a summary that filters by scope before counting. Counts are complete, not version-pinned — see the question.

steps.title: Each read meters itself
steps.body: Metadata, page and summary each authorise against the existing admission meter. A metadata failure no longer blocks rows.

steps.title: Proposed patterns — approve or redirect
steps.body:
Four hatched patterns are new to the catalog:
- sealed page history
- scope-first bounded read
- native index merge
- sealed continuation

steps.title: Sealed continuation
steps.body: The cursor is sealed with a deployment key. **Rollout:** every environment needs the key before deploy.

steps.title: The bulk collector goes
steps.body: Deleted with no fallback; `items.page` replaces it.

steps.title: Existing divergence DV-2
steps.body: Nothing enforces that a placement points at a real item. This change reads through it but does not fix it.
